title: 2026-11-05_Mirai_Botnet_Investigation_e0a
description: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a compromised network infected with the Mirai-Fbot botnet. Your goal is to identify and contain the malicious activities, including C2 communication, data collection, and flood attacks.
outcomes: Enumerate running services to identify suspicious activities.
Investigate systemd services and timers for persistence mechanisms.
Analyze network connections to detect unauthorized communication.
Contain and remediate the botnet infection.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a compromised network infected with the Mirai-Fbot botnet. Your goal is to identify and contain the malicious activities, including C2 communication, data collection, and flood attacks.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
Connect to the bot1 host using SSH with username 'cyrano' and password 'cyrano':
```bash
ssh cyrano@bot1
```
Enter the passkey 'start' to proceed.
levels.local_content:
Connect to the bot1 host using SSH with username 'cyrano' and password 'cyrano':
```bash
ssh cyrano@bot1
```
Enter the passkey 'start' to proceed.

levels.title: Identify the C2 Beacon Service
levels.content: Security monitoring has detected an unusual network-facing component on the compromised host. Investigate the running services and identify the service responsible for sending beacon periodically to the C2 Server.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the bot1 host using SSH:
```bash
ssh cyrano@bot1
```
2. List all systemd services to identify suspicious activities:
```bash
systemctl list-units --type=service --all
```
3. Look for unfamiliar service names or misspellings of legitimate services. Pay attention to services with unusual descriptions or startup behavior.
4. Identify the service responsible for sending beacon periodically to the C2 Server. The hidden flag is the name of this service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use `systemctl list-units --type=service --all` to list all services.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or descriptions.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The service responsible for sending beacon periodically to the C2 Server is likely to have a name related to "beacon" or "health".

levels.title: Determine the Network Port
levels.content: An unfamiliar network service appears to be involved in unauthorized communication with an external system. Investigate the service and determine the network port associated with this communication.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the bot1 host using SSH:
```bash
ssh cyrano@bot1
```
2. Inspect the C2 service definition to find the communication port:
```bash
systemctl cat bot-beacon.service
```
3. Pay particular attention to the `ExecStart` line, which specifies the path of the script launched by the service.
4. Check the script to find the communication port with the C2 server. The hidden flag is the port number.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use `systemctl cat <service>` to inspect the service definition.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for the `ExecStart` line in the service definition.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Check the script specified in the `ExecStart` line to find the communication port.

levels.title: Identify the Scheduling Component
levels.content: Investigators suspect that the C2 beacon service automatically resumes after the system starts and continues to execute periodically. Determine which system component is responsible for scheduling this activity.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the bot1 host using SSH:
```bash
ssh cyrano@bot1
```
2. List all systemd timers to identify the component responsible for scheduling the C2 beacon service:
```bash
systemctl list-timers --all
```
3. Identify the timer associated with the C2 beacon service. The hidden flag is the name of this timer.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use `systemctl list-timers --all` to list all timers.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for timers with names related to "beacon" or "health".

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The timer responsible for scheduling the C2 beacon service is likely to have a name similar to the service name but with a ".timer" suffix.
